items.text: IEA Governing Board: Accelerated IEA release includes over 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible.
IEA Governing Board encouraged those IEA members holding oil production and refining capacities to boost the supply of crude and refined products, particularly diesel.
IEA Governing Board agreed to accelerate the release of the remaining volumes.
